shadows.name: block-edge
shadows.purpose: Inset bottom edge on block body.

components.name: Primary CTA Block
components.description: Green cap block, the single primary action.
components.html: Get class dates by email
components.css: .ds-cta{display:inline-block;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 2px rgb(27 26 43 / .14));transition:transform 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),filter 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);text-decoration:none}.ds-cta-body{display:block;background:var(--color-operators,#2bb673);color:var(--color-ink,#1b1a2b);border-radius:8px;box-shadow:inset 0 -4px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / .14);padding:16px 24px;font-family:var(--font-display,sans-serif);font-weight:800;font-size:1.25rem}@media (hover:hover){.ds-cta:hover{transform:translate(-2px,-3px) rotate(-.6deg);filter:drop-shadow(0 10px 14px rgb(27 26 43 / .22))}}.ds-cta:active{transform:translate(0,2px);transition-duration:70ms}.ds-cta:focus-visible{outline:none;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 3px #ffc21a) drop-shadow(0 0 6px #ffc21a)}

components.name: Hat Block
components.description: Starts a script; rounded cap, no top notch.

components.name: Value Slot
components.description: White inset pill holding a value inside a block.

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Blue bar slides in on hover; yellow when current.

narrative.overview: The site is a block-coding editor a parent happens to be reading. Every section is a snap-together code block on a bright white stage with a faint dot grid.
keyCharacteristics: Flat blocks with inset edge and drop shadow

rules.name: The AA Text Rule
rules.body: Ink text on yellow, orange, green, teal, pink. White text on purple and blue.

rules.name: The Meaning Rule
rules.body: Yellow = hats/events/announcements. Green = primary action. Purple/blue/green/teal = Code/Build/Math/Physics.

rules.name: The Op Word Rule
rules.body: Op words are inline grammar inside a block, never eyebrow labels.

rules.name: The Dragged-Block Rule
rules.body: Only link/button blocks lift, only under hover:hover.

dos: Keep copy factual; minors first name plus grade only
donts: Don't build the generic edtech page
Don't use op words as eyebrows
Don't hardcode new hexes or rgb shadows
Don't add a second signature animation
